# Independent standards fixtures

The two PDF/A fixtures are an unmodified subset of the [veraPDF Consortium corpus](https://github.com/veraPDF/veraPDF-corpus/tree/377728596647e40edf16003d68d620773ce96ec5), revision `377728596647e40edf16003d68d620773ce96ec5`. They are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Copyright remains with the original authors. Source URLs and byte digests are recorded in `docs/independent-claims.json`.

Derived conversion artifacts are generated into the qualification packet, never substituted for these originals. These are development fixtures, not sealed evaluation outputs.
